payload.prompt: A photographic mecha scene makes the constructed body of a mechanical subject legible through a visible encounter between human and machine. At a repair bench, a short-haired woman works beside a human-sized service robot. Use the supplied portrait for the woman's face and hair appearance: preserve the visible facial proportions, dark eyes, short dark bob and wispy separated fringe. Her plain navy work shirt has its sleeves rolled back. Her quietly absorbed expression and relaxed mouth give her an unforced, subtly attractive presence. In the closed repair kiosk of a seaside ferry terminal after the final departure, the robot sits on the left and the woman sits on the right of a narrow workbench. The robot has a compact rounded head, a small optical face, a plainly mechanical neck and worn pale industrial body panels. A detached mechanical arm lies beside the machine's empty shoulder socket; frayed cables remain visible at both separated ends. Turn the robot's empty left shoulder socket toward the camera. Its detached left arm lies horizontally on a folded cloth below that socket, with a clear air gap between the socket rim and the detached upper-arm end. Short frayed cable strands emerge from inside the socket and separately from the arm's proximal end, both exposed against the pale casing. The detached arm's elbow and wrist remain connected; its opened forearm and upward-facing palm extend toward the woman. The robot's remaining right hand rests on the far bench edge. The woman steadies the exposed forearm frame with her left hand while her right hand seats a small driver against an accessible screw near the wrist. Her elbows stay outside the opened cavity. Her hands work at the wrist end, leaving the two separated shoulder ends unobstructed. Their heads incline toward the same repair point. Compose a horizontal medium photograph from a front three-quarter viewpoint slightly above bench height, with the woman's face, both working hands, the robot's head, its empty shoulder socket and the entire detached arm visible together. Sharp focus covers the exposed joint, separate cable ends and working contact in the same focal plane. Warm light dominates their skin, workbench and machine, while the terminal windows stay cool. A single task lamp and the empty boarding-hall depth retain a quiet ordinary working atmosphere. Tactile wear, restrained color and natural skin texture make this a believable documentary photograph of an invented ordinary night.
